name: Teferi's Moat — creatures of the chosen color without flying can't attack you
notes: The subject probe flagged 'without flying' as unread: no red witness on its board flies or has reach, so swapping the keyword changed nobody. The site was right all along; tests/sweep.js now adds a witness of the subject with the keyword ('the chosen color' as the sweep's red) when a keyword check is unread or inert. This recipe locks the behaviour in (it passes on the old code too): red chosen, the opponent's Hill Giant (red, no flying) can't attack Player 1; Shivan Dragon (red, flying) and Grizzly Bears (green) can; my own Raging Goblin gets nothing.
